soloDeveloper.description: Single developer building a project with factory assistance
steps: 1. User describes project → Codex runs Project Expertise Flow
2. User confirms architecture → Codex enters Build Lite
4. Codex executes tasks sequentially, updating memory
6. User reviews output, can request iteration
soloDeveloper.contextPacket: OPTIONAL — user can request REVIEWER_PACKET for review

teamLead.description: Team lead building complex multi-module project
steps: 1. User describes complex project → Codex suggests Build Pro
2. User CONFIRMS Build Pro → Codex verifies prerequisites
3. Readiness gate + Memory Quality gate must PASS
5. Codex decomposes into parallel task groups
6. For each spawn: AGENT_START_PACKET generated + validated
7. Agents execute with write scope enforcement
8. Close receipts + handoffs at each agent completion
10. Final verifier + negative controls before declaring done
teamLead.contextPacket: REQUIRED — at phase start, each spawn, recovery

manualBurden.buildPro: Moderate — user must confirm Build Pro, review context packets, check agent lifecycle
manualBurden.recommendation: Build Pro manual burden ~2x Build Lite but acceptable for complex projects
